test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: J, L, N, P, R, T, V and W are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. W is on the immediate left of J but not an immediate neighbour of P or R. T is on the immediate right of L. N has R and T as his immediate neighbours, V is immediate neighbour of R. Who is sitting to the immediate left of P?
solution:

1) W is sitting immediately left of J but not an neighbour of P or R.
